line: I got powers like a morpheus
vault_lines: I got powers like a morpheus
meaning: Morpheus is the Greek God of Dreams but in popular culture, is the mentor of Neo, (the chosen one), in The Matrix Trilogy.

Metaphor Rigor mortis is when a body stiffens after death and starts to smell. When weed smells very strongly; it is often dank-or of high quality. Wayne is saying he only smokes something that smells as strong as death.

line: And my killers look devoted My children look supported My cars look imported My dogs looking forward And the stars looking lower
meaning:
In this set of 5 bars, Wayne touches on a lot.
1. His killers are also people on his label who are ‘murdering beats’ and who have recently been destroying verses
2. Weezy has 4 children, 3 sons and a daughter Reginae, and maybe a 5th. Nevertheless; they all are rich since Wayne’s net-worth of {$90 million](http://ambrosiaforheads.com/2017/05/the-latest-forbes-rap-list-shows-drake-has-passed-wayne-has-birdman-in-his-sights/).
3. He has nice cars
4. His YM label is looking forward in 2018.
5. An expression to say that the stars are within reach.

Backwoods are a brand of cigars and cigarillos. The difference between a joint or a jay and a blunt is the type of paper being used to roll. Weezy uses personification in this line; saying that the blunt is overstuffed. This isn’t the first time Wayne has put an colossal amount of weed in a blunt.
